description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dion, adding {C}{C}.
When Dion dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dion from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dion enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Dion, Bahamut's Dominant // Bahamut, Warden of Light
